### 1 Introduction

#### 1.1 Scope
###### This document is part of the KNX HVAC Application Interworking Standard. It contains the specification of the Sensor Functional Blocks used for HVAC applications.

 Other general purpose Functional Blocks used for HVAC applications such as 'HVAC HMI' [03], 'HVAC Actuators' [04], 'HVAC Common Functions' [05] and 'HVAC Schedulers' [06] are described in separate documents.

 Functional Block specification for the applications 'Hot Water Heating' (HWH) [09], 'Direct Electric Heating' (DEH) [10], 'Terminal Units' (TU) [11] and 'Ventilation & Air Conditioning' (VAC) [12] are described in separate documents.

#### 1.2 Objectives
###### This document includes the information necessary to build interoperable HVAC Sensor products using the KNX system. Runtime process Interworking between HVAC control devices at the application level is the focus. Also data-interfaces for parameter setting, visualisation etc. are specified where appropriate (only state of the art Datapoints generally used in all companies).

 In addition, this document specifies the specific mechanisms for zoning and runtime process data distribution used in HVAC for an ‘easy installation’ system (LTE-Mode [13]).

 This is a technical specification with informative material provided as needed to convey key concepts. The approach taken here is a top-down view of interoperability. The HVAC system model is based on the decomposition of the distributed HVAC application by means of Functional Blocks, i.e. black-box description of Functional Blocks including data-interface and relationship to other Functional Blocks.

 Every Functional Block may be part of a complex device (e.g. a heating controller) containing more than one Functional Block. Because of this modular approach, there is no attempt in this specification to describe or dictate the internal construction of a Functional Block or to describe specific device types.

 This document only includes details of the transport protocol as needed to specify interoperability and easy installation mechanisms. The document does not specifically cover implementation aspects, but guidelines are included where appropriate.

 This part of the KNX HVAC specification is mainly but not completely independent of the underlying protocol since specific mechanisms for “easy configuration” and runtime data distribution must be available on the network.

 Completely protocol dependent parts of the HVAC Sensor Specification such as data encoding and Datapoint Types, object address tables, Group Address Tables etc. are not part of this document.


-----

#### 1.3 Dependence on Configuration Modes
###### The main focus of this document is the specification of the Basic Functional Blocks and the LTE specific parts.

 The document provides all necessary information needed:
 • for a complete implementation of the Functional Blocks in LTE-Mode
 • for the implementation of mandatory objects used for runtime Interworking in standard mode (Basic Functional Block)

##### 1.3.1 Runtime Interworking
###### Configuration Mode dependent (S-Mode, Ctrl-Mode, PB-Mode) implementation of optional runtime Interworking objects is not specified in this document, e.g. E-Mode Channel definitions.

##### 1.3.2 Parameters and Diagnostic Data
###### LTE implementation

 • Parameters and Diagnostic Data of a Functional Block shall be implemented as Properties of the corresponding Interface Object, which are accessed using individual addressing.

 • These Properties are addressed via the standard Interface Object Type (IO Type) for this Functional Block. This IO Type is also used for Datapoint addressing in the LTE runtime Interworking model.

 • Standard DPT or HVAC specific DPT with extended features are used where appropriate.

 Other modes

 • Parameters and Diagnostic Data can in principle be implemented as memory mapped Datapoints or Group Objects or Properties of an Interface Object using individual addressing. This document does not lay down how to implement Parameters and Diagnostic Data in S-Mode, Ctrl-Mode and PB-Mode.

 • In case of Memory Mapped Datapoints the DPT may be manufacturer specific

 • In case of Group Objects standard DPT shall be used instead of HVAC specific (extended) DPT. The description of these Group Objects shall be part of the mode-dependent specification (e.g. Channel definition).

 • In case of Properties, the implementation of HVAC specific DPT with extended features may be a problem (depending on the available microcontroller ressources). The manufacturer has the choice:

 - to use the LTE style Property implementation as specified in this document (with the DPT and IO Type for LTE implementations)   IO Type[used] = IO Type[HVAC-LTE]

 - to implement these Properties using standard DPT only.  In this case, the same Property ID but a different IO Type shall be used since the DPT of a Property shall be unambiguous for each IO Type.
**Simple IOT mapping rule:** **IO Type[used] = IO Type[standardDPT] = IO Type[HVAC-LTE] + 10000d**
###### (e.g. BUC[HVAC-LTE] = 128 => BUC[standardDPT] = 10128)
 - It is allowed to implement in a device both Interface Object Types IO Type[HVAC-LTE] and IO Type[standardDPT]. The implementation of parameters and diagnostic data of one given Functional Block shall however be complete. It is thus not allowed to implement part of the Datapoints of a Functional Block in IO Type[standardDPT] and the remaining in IO Type[HVAC-LTE.]

### 2 Formal matters

#### 2.1 Introduction to Functional Block
###### The Functional Blocks are described in a standard way as described below.

 Every Functional Block may be part of a complex device (e.g. a controller) containing more than one Functional Block.

 A Functional Block can never be split. Although not all Inputs, Outputs etc. are mandatory. The optional Inputs, Outputs do not have to be realised.

#### 2.2 Description of Functional Block

##### 2.2.1 Aims and objectives
###### This clause shall give a overview of the functionality of the Functional Block, as well as possible information about Interworking with other Functional Blocks.

##### 2.2.2 Functional specifications
###### This clause gives detailed information about the Inputs, the Outputs, the Parameters, the Diagnostic Data, the Alarms and the Hardwired I/O’s.

##### 2.2.3 Constraints
###### Constraints for the use of the Functional Block as well as for the use of Inputs, Outputs, Parameters, Diagnostic Data, Alarms etc. are described here.

##### 2.2.4 Functional Block diagram
###### On top of the Functional Block the name, Interface Object Type Identifier (IOTI) and the abbreviation are marked.

 Then the Inputs / Outputs are following.

 The Inputs / Outputs are grouped in Binding Groups, according to LTE (Logical Tag Extended). Each Input / Output is marked with the LTE-service (e.g. IR or W).

 Mandatory Inputs / Outputs have a grey arrow with the letter M. They also have to be available in the Standard Mode. Optional Inputs / Outputs have a white arrow. Some of the Inputs / Outputs, in case of being implemented, also have to be available in the Standard Mode. These Inputs / Outputs have a white arrow with the letter S.

 Some of the Inputs / Outputs only make sense in combination, others may be used either / or. Such Inputs / Outputs are grouped with numbers.

 At the bottom there are three fields:

 On the left-hand side we find the Hardwired Inputs / Outputs, the mandatory ones in a grey field, the optional ones in a white field. On the right-hand side there is a field for the Parameters and the Diagnostic Data used in the Functional Block (mandatory in grey, optional in white). On the right-hand side at the bottom there is the field for the Alarms, generated in the Functional Block (for use in the Functional Block Alarm Source).

#### 3.2 Outside Temperature Sensor (OTS)

##### 3.2.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Outside Temperature Sensor’ measures the outside air temperature and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Outside Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the outside temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.2.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the outside temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the ‘Outside Temperature Sensor’ supports LTE outside sensor zoning, i.e. multiple outside temperature values may be distributed in the system in parallel for different zones. (e.g. OutsideSensorZone_1= ‘north’, OutsideSensorZone_2= ‘south’ etc.).

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempOutside This Output delivers the outside temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempOutside.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • OutsideSensorZone no special features

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.2.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **OTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempOutside** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the outside temperature as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,2 [1) ]
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical
Application Specific OutsideSensorZone 1
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 320 (OTS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)]

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter

###### 3.2.6.3 Parameter OutsideSensorZone

**FB:** **OTS** **Property Name (Server):** **OutsideSensorZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the outside sensor zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Sensor Zone Number of the sensor zone 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 320 (OTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone = 0 (wildcard) NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.2.6.4 Parameter TempCorrValue

**FB:** **OTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempCorrValue** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**

**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACRel_Z DPT ID 205.101 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Temperature Temperature correction value Full Range K

 - OutofService correction active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set correction inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 320 (OTS) Property ID: 111
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value

#### 3.3 Room Temperature Sensor (RTS)

##### 3.3.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Room Temperature Sensor’ measures the room temperature and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Room Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the room temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.3.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the room temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Room Temperature Sensor' supports the LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempRoom This Output delivers the room temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempRoom.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.3.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1. Wildcard on apartment is NOT allowed.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempRoom** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the room temperature as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,2 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false

###### 3.3.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RTS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone
NA 0
M 1...126
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 321 (RTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone = 0 (wildcard): NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.3.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RTS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory [*)]  Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 321 (RTS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.3.2.

###### 3.3.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RTS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 321 (RTS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.3.2.

###### 3.3.6.9 Parameter TempAlarmLimitLower

**FB:** **RTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempAlarmLimitLower** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Lower temperature value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Temperature Temperature limit value Full Range °C
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 321 (RTS) Property ID: 114
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.3.6.10 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB:** **RTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 321 (RTS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.3.6.11 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB:** **RTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime**

**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID
Field Description
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 321 (RTS)
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.4 Supply Air Temperature Sensor (SATS)

##### 3.4.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Supply Air Temperature Sensor’ measures the supply air temperature e.g. in a distribution duct and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Supply Air Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the supply air temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.4.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the supply air temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Supply Air Temperature Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning:
 - "Apartment . Room . SubZone",
 - "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempSupplyAir This Output delivers the supply air temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempSupplyAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. DistrSegmV For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. GenPeripheral It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.4.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.4.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **SATS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempSupplyAir** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the supply air temperature as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,2 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific DistrSegmV 1 [2)]
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322 (SATS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter

2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.4.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **SATS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322(SATS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.4.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **SATS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322 (SATS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.4.6.7 Parameter  DistrSegmV

**FB:** **SATS** **Property Name (Server):** **DistrSegmV** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the ventilation distribution segment.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the ventilation distribution 1...31
segment

STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322 (SATS) Property ID: 105
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.4.6.11 Parameter TempAlarmLimitLower

**FB:** **SATS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempAlarmLimitLower** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Lower temperature value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Temperature Temperature limit value Full Range °C
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322 (SATS) Property ID: 114
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.4.6.12 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB:** **SATS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322 (SATS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.4.6.13 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB:** **SATS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime**

**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID
Field Description
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 322 (SATS)
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.5 Return Air Temperature Sensor (RNATS)

##### 3.5.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Return Air Temperature Sensor’ measures the return air temperature e.g. in a distribution duct and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Return Air Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the return air temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.5.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the return air temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Return Air Temperature Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning:
 - "Apartment . Room . SubZone",
 - "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempReturnAir This Output delivers the return air temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempReturnAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.5.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm. 


-----

###### • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.5.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RNATS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempReturnAir** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the return air temperature as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,2 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 323 (RNATS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport

Output per default communicating [Binding Group Wildcard allowed   ]

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.5.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RNATS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 323 (RNATS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.5.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RNATS** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 323 (RNATS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.5.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RNATS** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 323 (RNATS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.5.6.11 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB:** **RNATS Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 323 (RNATS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.5.6.12 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB:** **RNATS Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 323 (RNATS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.6 Flow Water Temperature Sensor (FWTS)

##### 3.6.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Flow Water Temperature Sensor’ measures the flow water temperature e.g. of a hot water distribution and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Flow Water Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the flow water temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.6.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the flow water temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Flow Water Temperature Sensor', depending on the implementation may support the following LTE zoning: (if implemented with other FB’s at least one, if implemented as a proper device as many as possible)
 - "Apartment . Room . SubZone",
 - "DistrSegmHeat"
 - "DistrSegmCool"
 - "ProdSegmHeat"
 - "ProdSegmCool"
 - "GenPeripheral".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempFlowWater This Output delivers the flow water temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempFlowWater

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. DistrSegmH For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. DistrSegmC It is even possible to have more than one binding group ProdSegmH active. The binding groups that shall not be active have ProdSegmC to be set to out of service. GenPeripheral Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.6.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.


-----

###### Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at  which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.6.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **FWTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempFlowWater** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the flow water temperature as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific DistrSegmH 1 [2)]
Application Specific DistrSegmC 1 [2)]
Application Specific ProdSegmH 1 [2)]
Application Specific ProdSegmC 1 [2)]

Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.6.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **FWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.6.2.

 3.6.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **FWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.6.2.

###### 3.6.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **FWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.6.2.

###### 3.6.6.7 Parameter DistrSegmC

**FB:** **FWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **DistrSegmC** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the distribution segment cooling.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of DistrSegmC (0) 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 105
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.6.2.

Optional
**Description:**

**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of ProdSegmC (0) 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 107
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.6.6.15 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB:** **FWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

#### 3.7 Return Water Temperature Sensor (RNWTS)

##### 3.7.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Return Water Temperature Sensor’ measures the return water temperature e.g. of a hot water distribution and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Return Water Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the return water temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.7.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the return water temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the ‘Return Water Temperature Sensor', depending on the implementation may support the following LTE zoning: (if implemented with other FB’s at least one, if implemented as a proper device as many as possible)
 - "Apartment . Room . SubZone",
 - "DistrSegmHeat"
 - "DistrSegmCool"
 - "ProdSegmHeat"
 - "ProdSegmCool"
 - "GenPeripheral".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempReturnWater This Output delivers the return water temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempReturnWater.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. DistrSegmH For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. DistrSegmC It is even possible to have more than one binding group ProdSegmH active. The binding groups that shall not be active have ProdSegmC to be set to out of service. GenPeripheral Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.7.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.


-----

###### Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.7.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RNWTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempReturnWater** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the return water temperature as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific DistrSegmH 1 [2)]
Application Specific DistrSegmC 1 [2)]
Application Specific ProdSegmH 1 [2)]
Application Specific ProdSegmC 1 [2)]
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 325 (RNWTS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.7.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RNWTS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 325 (RNWTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.7.2.

 3.7.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RNWTS** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 325 (RNWTS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.7.2.

###### 3.7.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RNWTS** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 325 (RNWTS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.7.2.

Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners

###### 3.7.6.15 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB: RNWTS Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 325 (RNWTS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.7.6.16 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB: RNWTS Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 325 (RNWTS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.8 Water Change Over Status Sensor (WCOS)

##### 3.8.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Water Change Over Status Sensor’ acquires the temperature/status of the water, supplied e.g. to the fancoil and provides the information ‘Heating’ or ‘Cooling’ to the system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a 'Water Change Over Status Sensor Device' or in a more complex device that contains this functionality.

 The temperature/status may be acquired internal (hardwired sensor) or via BUS. In case of status acquisition via BUS, the Functional Block transforms an ‘ON/OFF’ information to the ‘Heating’ / ‘Cooling’ information. An additional Input offers a manual change of the change over mode. This Input is used for manual override of the detected status.

##### 3.8.2 Functional Specification
###### The distribution of the ChangeOverStatusWater in the system is event driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Water Change Over Status Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning:
 - "DistrSegemH"
 - "DistrSegemC"
 - "GenPeripheral"

 The Output information is ‘Heating’ or ‘Cooling’. In case of a temperature measurement, the level values may be set with parameters, in case of a switch the switch interpretation (normally open or normally closed) can be set.

 Optional functions:
 - Faults in the sensor may be detected and reported.
 - The status value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purpose.   The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.

 Inputs

 • TempFlowWater This Input takes the temperature from a sensor. By means of the parameters the Functional Block defines the change over status. This Input is used alternatively with the switch.

 • ChangeOverSwitch This Input takes the information from a normal switch. The relation on/off to heating/cooling may be defined by means of a parametrer. Binding only is possible in the Standard Mode. This Input is used alternatively with the temperature.

 • ChangeOverMode This Input receives the information from a HMI (e.g. switch) which is operated by e.g. a person who is responsible for the heating/cooling. This Input has higher priority than the others. In the position AUTO the Input of the other Inputs is valid.

 Outputs

 • ChangeOverStatusWater This Output delivers the information heating or cooling to the controllers, in order to change the controller sequence.


-----

###### Binding Groups (LTE)

 • DistrSegmH This sensor can be used in different applications. DistrSegmC For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. General Peripheral Tag It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised.

 Parameters

 • TempHeatingLevel If the temperature of the sensor is higher than this value, the Functional Block delivers heating to the system.

 • TempCoolingLevel If the temperature of the sensor is lower than this value, the Functional Block delivers cooling to the system.

 • SwitchDefinitionHeat/Cool Company specific definition of the relation between the hardware switch position and the bus information.

 • Heartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition (change of the Water Change Over Status) occurred before.

 • MinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.8.3 Constraints
###### The Input ‘ChangeOverSwitch’ only can be used in the S-Mode as a corresponding switch is not defined.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **WCOS** **LTE Client** **TempFlowWater** Mandatory
**Input Name:** Optional

**Description:**
This information is provided by the flow water temperature sensor.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Unit
Temp Temperature value °C
STATUS Bitset
Bit 0 - OutOfService Function out of Service M t/f
Bit 1 - Fault Information is corrupted M t/f
Bit 2 - Overridden Information is temporarily overridden O t/f
Bit 3 - InAlarm Information with alarm O t/f
Bit 4- AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O t/f
all other bits NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**

Class Type Default

Geographical

Application Specific ProdSegmH [1)] 1 [1)]
Application Specific DistrSegmC [1)] 1 [1)]
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [1)]

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 324 (FWTS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-service (event):** InfoReport Sniffer on Binding Group: -
InfoReport Timeout: 31 Min

**LTE-service (polling):** Read Wildcard / Resp Sniffer on Binding

-
Read – Response Group:

**Value after Power-up:** Default Value Stored Value
**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**
1) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding

group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised.

###### 3.8.6.5 Parameter DistrSegmH

**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the distribution segment heating.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of DistrSegmH (0) 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

###### 3.8.6.7 Parameter GenPeripheral

**FB:** **WCOS** **Property Name** **GenPeripheral** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the general peripheral tag.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue16_Z DPT ID 203.012 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of general peripheral tag full
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 342 (WCOS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.8.6.11 Parameter Heartbeat

**FB:** **WCOS Property Name (Server):** **Heartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 342 (WCOS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.8.6.12 Parameter MinRepTime

**FB:** **WCOS Property Name (Server):** **MinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 342 (WCOS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time; minimum repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.10 Sun Intensity Sensor (SIS)

##### 3.10.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Sun Intensity Sensor’ measures the current sun intensity information in W/m[2 ]and provides the data to the bus / system. Sun intensity sensor data is mainly used for HVAC whereas ‘Light Brightness Sensor’, which provides Lux information, is used in shutters and blinds or in the lighting applications.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a stand alone ‘Sun Intensity Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the sun intensity sensor functionality.

##### 3.10.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the sun intensity in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 In the LTE-Mode the ‘Sun Intensity Sensor’ supports LTE outside sensor zoning, i.e. multiple sun intensity values may be distributed in the system in parallel for different zones. (e.g. OutsideSensorZone_1= ‘north’, OutsideSensorZone_2= ‘south’ etc.).

 Optional features in LTE-Mode: - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.

 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes. The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.

 - Upper alarm limit may be detected by the sensor and reported. The alarm may be acknowledged.

 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • SunIntensity This Output provides the sun intensity to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output SunIntensity.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • OutsideSensorZone no special features

 Parameters

 • SunIntensityCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta W/m[2] value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • SunIntensityAlarmLimit This value can be used to create an alarm. 

 • Heartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • MinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.10.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **SIS** **LTE Server Output Name: Sun Intensity** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the sun intensity sensor as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_SunIntensity_Z DPT ID 203.102 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
SunIntensity Current sun intensity value Full Range W/m[2] 10 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical
Application Specific OutsideSensorZone 1
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable

###### 3.10.6.3 Parameter OutsideSensorZone

**FB:** **SIS** **Property Name (Server):** **OutsideSensorZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the outside sensor zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Sensor Zone Number of the sensor zone 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 348 (SIS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.10.6.5 Parameter SunIntensityAlarmLimit

**FB:** **SIS** **Property Name (Server): SunIntensityAlarmLimit** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
If SunIntensity is above this value an alarm can be generated (upper limit)
Remark: for Sun Intensity only this alarm limit is relevant. It is not useful to have a lower alarm limit.
**DPT:** Name DPT_SunIntensity_Z DPT ID 203.102 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
SunIntensity SunIntensity alarm limit value Full Range W/m[2]
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 348 (SIS) Property ID: 113
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.10.6.6 Parameter Heartbeat

**FB:** **SIS** **Property Name (Server):** **Heartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 348 (SIS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.10.6.7 Parameter MinRepTime

**FB:** **SIS** **Property Name (Server):** **MinRepTime**

**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID
Field Description
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 348 (SIS)
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable
