#### 3.11 Window Switch (WOS)

##### 3.11.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Window Switch‘ is dedicated to HVAC applications and NOT to security applications. It acquires the status of one or several windows in a room and provides the result to the bus.

 The Functional Block allows to have only one or many windows in the same ‘Binding Group’ without any different engineering.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Window Switch Device’ or in a more complex device that has the window switch functionality.

##### 3.11.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the WindowStatus in the system is event driven (COV-condition, change of value). It is NOT repeated periodically.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Window Switch' supports the LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone".

 The Functional Block contains one Input and 2 Outputs. The Inputs and Outputs ‘WindowSwitch’ are only for interaction between different ‘Window Switches’. The Output ‘WindowStatus’ is the result of all ‘Window Switches’ and is delayed (e.g. 10 s) in order to prevent from toggling. (see description below.) This information is used in the ‘Room Setpoint Manager’.

 Description of the functionality

 If one of the windows is opened, ‘WindowStatus’ immediately is delivering open.

 If one of the windows changes to closed the corresponding ‘Window Switch’ block provides ‘WindowSwitch’ close to the bus. All ‘Window Switches’ (in the same Binding Group) will receive this information. Those blocks with the windows closed will not react. Those blocks with an open window will immediately send ‘WindowSwitch’ open. This information again is distributed to all blocks in the same Binding Group (also the block where the window got closed). In this case this particular block does NOT send ‘WindowStatus’ closed. If no other window is open, no other block will react and the initial block after a certain delay will send ‘WindowStatus’ closed.

 Simple Window Switch

 It is possible to implement a simple window switch, only using the Output WindowStatus. In this case only one window switch may be in the same binding group.

 Inputs

 • WindowSwitch This Input is used for the information from other window switches (see example and state diagram below) (optional if no co-ordination with other window switches desired.)

 Outputs

 • WindowSwitch This Output is used for the information to other window switches (see example and state diagram below) (optional if no co-ordination with other window switches desired.)

 • WindowStatus This Output is provided to the controller.


-----

###### Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone Apartment and room have to be spezified. Wildcard only is allowed with SubZone.

 Parameters

 • SwitchDefinitionWindow Company specific definition of the relation between the hardware switch position and the bus information.

 • Delay This parameter defines the delay of the WindowStatus information (see example and state diagram below). This delay may be fix (no parameter).

 • Heartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the WindowStatus if no COV condition (change of any of the Window Switches) occurred before.

 • MinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the WindowStatus even if a COV condition (change of any of the Window Switches) occurred before. Note: this parameter is only meaningful if parameter Delay is  implemented and if Delay > MinRepTime.

##### 3.11.3 Constraints
###### If the Functional Block is implemented in a simple controller, it may be implemented with only the Output WindowStatus.

 In this case it will NOT be possible to combine it with other bus window switches.

###### 3.11.6.4 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **WOS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone
NA 0
M 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 343 (WOS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone = 0 (wildchard): NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.11.6.6 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **WOS** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 343 (WOS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.11.6.8 Parameter Delay

**FB:** **WOS** **Property Name** **Delay** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
This parameter defines the delay to the action.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 07.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
full s
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 343 (WOS) Property ID: 112
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.11.6.9 Parameter Heartbeat

**FB:** **WOS** **Property Name (Server):** **Heartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the window status if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 343 (WOS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

#### 3.12 Presence Detector (PRD)

##### 3.12.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Presence Detector’ acquires the presence status and provides it to the system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Presence Detector Device’, in a ‘Presence Detector Switch Device’ or in a more complex device that has the presence detector functionality.

##### 3.12.2 Functional Specification
###### The distribution of the PresenceStatus in the system is event driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Presence Detector' supports the LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone".

 The presence status e.g. can be acquired by means of a sensor (automatic), described here or by means of a switch (manual), see [03] User Presence Switch..

 The information is transmitted spontaneously at each change.

 Outputs

 • PresenceStatus This Output provides the status of a presence sensor to the system. Delays for switching on and switching off may be applied (see parameters).

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone no special features

 Parameters

 • SwitchDefinitionPresence Company specific definition of the relation between the relation between the hardware switch/detector position and the bus information.

 • SwitchOnDelay This delay may be applied to delay the ON, e.g. if somebody is entering a room for only a few moments.

 • SwitchOffDelay This delay may be applied to delay the OFF, e.g. if there is no detection for some time, although somebody is present. 

 • Heartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition (change of Presence Status) occurred before.

 • MinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.12.3 Constraints
###### This Functional Block is NOT dedicated to security applications.

 There are different delay demands for HVAC applications and for light applications. In plants with both demands, it is necessary to use two detectors or one detector with different Outputs (delay).

###### 3.12.6.2 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **PRD** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**

**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126 1
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0 false

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA false
COMMAND enum cs

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 345 (PRD) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.12.6.3 Parameter Room

**FB:** **PRD** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 345 (PRD) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

**FB:** **PRD** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory

Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 345 (PRD) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.12.6.9 Parameter MinRepTime

**FB:** **PRD** **Property Name (Server):** **MinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 345 (PRD) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time; minimum repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.13 Outside AQ Sensor (OAQS)

##### 3.13.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Outside AQ Sensor’ measures the outside air quality and delivers it to the bus / system.

 The measurement of the air quality is in ppm CO2. Other gases are converted to ppm CO2.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Outside Air Quality Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the outside air quality sensor functionality.

##### 3.13.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the outside air quality in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the ‘Outside Air Quality Sensor’ supports LTE outside sensor zoning,  i.e. multiple outside air quality values may be distributed in the system in parallel for different zones. (e.g. OutsideSensorZone_1= ‘north’, OutsideSensorZone_2= ‘south’ etc.).

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.   The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.   The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • AQOutside This Output delivers the outside air quality value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output AQOutside.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • OutsideSensorZone no special features

 Parameters

 • AQCorrValue This parameter defines the correction value for the sensor

 • AQCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta AQ value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • AQAlarmLimit This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • AQHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • AQMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

 • Altitude This parameter defines the altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the measurement.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **OAQS** **LTE Server Output Name: AQOutside** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the outside air quality as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Air quality Actual AQ value Full Range ppm 10 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical
Application Specific OutsideSensorZone 1
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 330 (OAQS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)]

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

###### 3.13.6.3 Parameter OutsideSensorZone

**FB:** **OAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **OutsideSensorZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the outside sensor zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Sensor Zone Number of the sensor zone 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 330 (OAQS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone = 0 (wildcard) NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value

###### 3.13.6.7 Parameter AQHeartbeat

**FB:** **OAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 330 (OAQS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.13.6.8 Parameter AQMinRepTime

**FB:** **OAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 330 (OAQS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

###### 3.13.6.9 Parameter Altitude

**FB:** **OAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Altitude** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the
measurement.
**DPT:** Name DPT_Length_m DPT ID 8.012 Datatype format V16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Altitude above sea level, in meters Full m 0 [1)]
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 330 (OAQS) Property ID: 117
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) ex-factory default setting is device-specific;

any default value may be faulty for the installed device. 0 meters above sea level may be interpreted
as the most neutral “faulty” value

#### 3.14 Room AQ Sensor (RAQS)

##### 3.14.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Room AQ Sensor’ measures the room air quality and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 The measurement of the air quality is in ppm CO2. Other gases are converted to ppm CO2.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Room Air Quality Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the room air quality sensor functionality.

##### 3.14.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the room air quality in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Room AQ Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone", "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • AQRoom This Output delivers the room AQ value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output AQRoom.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints in clause 3.14.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1. Wildcard on apartment is NOT allowed.

 Parameters

 • AQCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • AQCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta air quality value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • AQAlarmLimit This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • AQHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • AQMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

 • Altitude This parameter defines the altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the measurement.

##### 3.14.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RAQS** **LTE Server Output Name: AQRoom** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the room air quality as well as a STATUS information. The Output may
be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Air quality Actual AQ value Full Range ppm 10 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed [3)]

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

[3)] Wildcard on apartment is NOT allowed

###### 3.14.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone
NA 0
M 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone = 0 (wildcard): NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.14.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.14.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.14.2.

###### 3.14.6.9 Parameter AQAlarmLimit

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQAlarmLimit** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Air quality value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Air quality AQ limit value Full Range ppm
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 113
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.14.6.10 Parameter AQHeartbeat

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.14.6.11 Parameter AQMinRepTime

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s 10
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

###### 3.14.6.12 Parameter Altitude

**FB:** **RAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Altitude** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the
measurement.
**DPT:** Name DPT_Length_m DPT ID 8.012 Datatype format V16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Altitude above sea level, in meters Full m 0 [1)]
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 331 (RAQS) Property ID: 117
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) ex-factory default setting is device-specific;

any default value may be faulty for the installed device. 0 meters above sea level may be interpreted
as the most neutral “faulty” value

#### 3.15 Supply AQ Sensor (SAQS)

##### 3.15.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Supply AQ Sensor’ measures the supply air quality and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 The measurement of the air quality is in ppm CO2. Other gases are converted to ppm CO2.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Supply Air Quality Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the supply air quality sensor functionality.

##### 3.15.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the supply air quality in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Supply AQ Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone", "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • AQSupplyAir This Output delivers the supply AQ value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output AQSupplyAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.15.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • AQCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • AQCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta air quality value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • AQAlarmLimit This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • AQHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • AQMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

 • Altitude This parameter defines the altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the measurement.

##### 3.15.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **SAQS** **LTE Server Output Name: AQSupplyAir** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the supply air quality as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Air quality Actual AQ value Full Range ppm 10 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.15.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.15.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.15.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *) See functional specifications in clause 3.15.2.

###### 3.15.6.9 Parameter AQAlarmLimit

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQAlarmLimit** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Air quality value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Air quality AQ limit value Full Range ppm
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 113
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.15.6.10 Parameter AQHeartbeat

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.15.6.11 Parameter AQMinRepTime

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s 10
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

###### 3.15.6.12 Parameter Altitude

**FB:** **SAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Altitude** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the
measurement.
**DPT:** Name DPT_Length_m DPT ID 8.012 Datatype format V16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Altitude above sea level, in meters Full m 0 [1)]
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 332 (SAQS) Property ID: 117
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) ex-factory default setting is device-specific;

any default value may be faulty for the installed device. 0 meters above sea level may be interpreted
as the most neutral “faulty” value

#### 3.16 Return AQ Sensor (RNAQS)

##### 3.16.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Return AQ Sensor’ measures the return air quality and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 The measurement of the air quality is in ppm CO2. Other gases are converted to ppm CO2.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Return Air Quality Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the return air quality sensor functionality.

##### 3.16.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the return air quality in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Return AQ Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone", "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • AQReturnAir This Output delivers the return AQ value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output AQReturnAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.16.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • AQCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • AQCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta air quality value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • AQAlarmLimit This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • AQHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • AQMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

 • Altitude This parameter defines the altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the measurement.

##### 3.16.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RNAQS** **LTE Server Output Name: AQReturnAir** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the return air quality as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Air quality Actual AQ value Full Range ppm 10 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.16.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RNAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.16.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RNAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *) See functional specifications in clause 3.16.2.

###### 3.16.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RNAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *) See functional specifications in clause 3.16.2.

###### 3.16.6.9 Parameter AQAlarmLimit

**FB:** **RNAQS** **Property Name (Server):** **AQAlarmLimit** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Air quality value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_HVACAirQual_Z DPT ID 203.100 Datatype format U16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Air quality AQ limit value Full Range ppm
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 113
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.16.6.10 Parameter AQHeartbeat

**FB: RNAQS Property Name (Server):** **AQHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.16.6.11 Parameter AQMinRepTime

**FB: RNAQS Property Name (Server):** **AQMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s 10
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

###### 3.16.6.12 Parameter Altitude

**FB: RNAQS Property Name (Server):** **Altitude** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Altitude above sea level of the installed Air Quality Sensor to compensate altitude effects on the
measurement.
**DPT:** Name DPT_Length_m DPT ID 8.012 Datatype format V16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Altitude above sea level, in meters Full m 0 [1)]
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 333 (RNAQS) Property ID: 117
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) ex-factory default setting is device-specific;

any default value may be faulty for the installed device. 0 meters above sea level may be interpreted
as the most neutral “faulty” value

#### 3.17 Supply Air Relative Humidity Sensor (SARHS)

##### 3.17.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Supply Air Relative Humidity Sensor’ measures the supply air relative humidity and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Supply Air Relative Humidity Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the supply air relative humidity sensor functionality.

##### 3.17.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the supply air relative humidity value in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Supply Air Relative Humidity Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone", "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • HumRelSupplyAir This Output delivers the supply air relative humidity value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output HumRelSupplyAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.17.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • HumRelCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • HumRelCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta relative humidity value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • HumRelHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • HumRelMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.17.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **SARHS** **LTE Server Output** **HumRelSupplyAir** Mandatory
**Name:** Optional

**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the supply air relative humidity as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_RelValue_Z DPT ID 202.001 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Relative Humidity Actual relative humidity value Full Range % 5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 338 (SARHS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.17.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **SARHS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 338 (SARHS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.17.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **SARHS** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 338 (SARHS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.17.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **SARHS** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 338 (SARHS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.17.2.

###### 3.17.6.11 Parameter HumRelHeartbeat

**FB:** **SARHS Property Name (Server):** **HumRelHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 338 (SARHS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.17.6.12 Parameter HumRelMinRepTime

**FB:** **SARHS Property Name (Server):** **HumRelMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 338 (SARHS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.18 Return Air Relative Humidity Sensor (RNARHS)

##### 3.18.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Return Air Relative Humidity Sensor’ measures the return air relative humidity and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Return Air Relative Humidity Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the return air relative humidity sensor functionality.

##### 3.18.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the return air relative humidity value in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Return Air Relative Humidity Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone", "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • HumRelReturnAir This Output delivers the return air relative humidity value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output HumRelSupplyAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.18.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • HumRelCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • HumRelCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta relative humidity value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • HumRelHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • HumRelMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.18.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RNARHS** **LTE Server Output Name: HumRelSupplyAir** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the return air relative humidity as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_RelValue_Z DPT ID 202.001 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Relative Humidity Actual relative humidity value Full Range % 5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 339 (RNARHS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.18.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RNARHS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 339 (RNARHS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.18.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RNARHS** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 339 (RNARHS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.18.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RNARHS** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 339 (RNARHS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.18.2.

###### 3.18.6.11 Parameter HumRelHeartbeat

**FB: RNARHS Property Name (Server): HumRelHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 339 (RNARHS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.18.6.12 Parameter HumRelMinRepTime

**FB: RNARHS Property Name (Server): HumRelMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of sensor [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 339 (RNARHS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.19 Outside Relative Humidity Sensor (ORHS)

##### 3.19.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Outside Relative Humidity Sensor’ measures the outside relative humidity and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Outside Relative Humidity Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the outside relative humidity sensor functionality.

##### 3.19.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the outside relative humidity value in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the ‘Outside Relative Humidity Sensor’ supports LTE outside sensor zoning,  i.e. multiple outside relative humidity values may be distributed in the system in parallel for different zones. (e.g. OutsideSensorZone_1= ‘north’, OutsideSensorZone_2= ‘south’ etc.).

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.   The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.   The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • HumRelOutside This Output delivers the outside relative humidity value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output AQOutside.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • OutsideSensorZone no special features

 Parameters

 • HumRelCorrValue This parameter defines the correction value for the sensor

 • HumRelCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta relative humidity value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • HumRelHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • HumRelMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.
