###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **ORHS** **LTE Server Output Name: HumRelOutside** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the outside relative humidity as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_RelValue_Z DPT ID 202.001 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Relative humidity Actual relative humidity value Full Range % 5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical
Application Specific OutsideSensorZone 1
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable

###### 3.19.6.3 Parameter OutsideSensorZone

**FB:** **ORHS** **Property Name (Server):** **OutsideSensorZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the outside sensor zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Sensor Zone Number of the sensor zone 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 336 (ORHS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone 0 (wildcard) NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.19.6.4 Parameter HumRelCorrValue

**FB:** **ORHS** **Property Name (Server):** **HumRelCorrValue** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**

**DPT:** Name DPT_RelSignedValue_Z DPT ID 204.001 Datatype format V8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Relative humidity Relative humidity correction value Full Range %

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set correction inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 336 (ORHS) Property ID: 111
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value

###### 3.19.6.7 Parameter HumRelAlarmLimitLower

**FB:** **ORHS** **Property Name (Server):** **HumRelAlarmLimitLower** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Lower relative humidity value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_RelValue_Z DPT ID 202.001 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Relative humidity Relative humidity limit value Full Range %
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 336 (ORHS) Property ID: 114
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.19.6.8 Parameter HumRelHeartbeat

**FB:** **ORHS** **Property Name (Server):** **HumRelHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 336 (ORHS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.19.6.9 Parameter HumRelMinRepTime

**FB:** **ORHS** **Property Name (Server):** **HumRelMinRepTime**

**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID
Field Description
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 336 (ORHS)
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.20 Room Relative Humidity Sensor (RRHS)

##### 3.20.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Room Relative Humidity Sensor’ measures the room relative humidity and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Room Relative Humidity Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the room relative humidity sensor functionality.

##### 3.20.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the room relative humidity value in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Return Air Relative Humidity Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone", "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • HumRelRoom This Output delivers the room relative humidity value to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output HumRelSupplyAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints in clause 3.20.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1. Wildcard on apartment is NOT allowed.

 Parameters

 • HumRelCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • HumRelCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta relative humidity value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • HumRelAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • HumRelHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • HumRelMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.20.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **RRHS** **LTE Server Output Name: HumRelRoom** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the room relative humidity as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_RelValue_Z DPT ID 202.001 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Relative Humidity Actual relative humidity value Full Range % 5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 337 (RRHS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed [3)]

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

[3)] Wildcard in apartment NOT allowed

###### 3.20.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **RRHS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone
NA 0
M 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 337 (RRHS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): NOT allowed
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.20.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **RRHS** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 337 (RRHS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *) See functional specifications in clause 3.20.2.

 3.20.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **RRHS** **Property Name** **SubZone** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 337 (RRHS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.20.2.

###### 3.20.6.12 Parameter HumRelMinRepTime

**FB:** **RRHS** **Property Name (Server):** **HumRelMinRepTime**

**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID
Field Description
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 337 (RRHS)
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

#### 3.21 Condenser Flow Water Temperature Sensor (CFWTS)

##### 3.21.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Condenser Flow Water Temperature Sensor’ measures the flow water temperature in the condenser circuit of a chiller and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Condenser Flow Water Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the condenser flow water temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.21.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the flow water temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Condenser Flow Water Temperature Sensor' supports  the following LTE zoning:
 - "ProdSegmCool"
 - "GenPeripheral".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempFlowWaterCond This Output delivers the condenser flow water temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempFlowWaterCond

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • ProdSegmC This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. . It is even possible to have more than one binding group . active. The binding groups that shall not be active have . to be set to out of service. . Not all possibilities have to be realised.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.


-----

###### • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.21.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **CFWTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempFlowWaterCond** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the condenser flow water temperature as well as a STATUS
information. The Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA

###### 3.21.6.3 Parameter ProdSegmC

**FB:** **CFWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **ProdSegmC** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the production segment cooling.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of ProdSegmC (0) 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 326 (CFWTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

--**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.21.6.9 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB: CFWTS Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 326 (CFWTS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.21.6.10 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB: CFWTS Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 326 (CFWTS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.22 Condenser Return Water Temperature Sensor (CRNWTS)

##### 3.22.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Condenser Return Water Temperature Sensor’ measures the return water temperature in the condenser circuit of a chiller and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Condenser Return Water Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the condenser return water temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.22.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the flow water temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Condenser Return Water Temperature Sensor' supports  the following LTE zoning:
 - "ProdSegmCool"
 - "GenPeripheral".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempReturnWaterCond This Output delivers the condenser return water temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempReturnWaterCond

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • ProdSegmC This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm. 

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.


-----

###### • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.22.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **CRNWTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempReturnWaterCond** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the condenser return water temperature as well as a STATUS
information. The Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,5 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical
Application Specific ProdSegmC [2)] 1 [2)]

Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 327 (CRNWTS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised.

###### 3.22.6.3 Parameter ProdSegmC

**FB:** **CRNWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **ProdSegmC** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the production segment cooling.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of ProdSegmC (0) 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 327 (CRNWTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

Optional

Field Description Sup. Range Unit

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 327 (CRNWTS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.22.6.9 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB: CRNWTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
of sensor value

**Communication:**

#### 3.23 Air Change Over Status Sensor (ACOS)

##### 3.23.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Air Change Over Status Sensor’ acquires the temperature/status of the air, supplied e.g. to the VAV control and provides the information ‘Heating’ or ‘Cooling’ to the system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a 'Air Change Over Status Sensor Device' or in a more complex device that contains this functionality.

 The temperature/status may be acquired internal (hardwired sensor) or via BUS. In case of status acquisition via BUS, the Functional Block transforms an ‘ON/OFF’ information to the ‘Heating’ / ‘Cooling’ information. An additional Input offers a manual change of the change over mode. This Input is used for manual override of the detected status.

##### 3.23.2 Functional Specification
###### The distribution of the ChangeOverStatusAir in the system is event driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Air Change Over Status Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning:
 - "DistrSegemV"
 - "GenPeripheral"

 The Output information is ‘Heating’ or ‘Cooling’. In case of a temperature measurement, the level values may be set with parameters, in case of a switch the switch interpretation (normally open or normally closed) can be set.

 Optional functions:
 - Faults in the sensor may be detected and reported.
 - The status value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purpose.   The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.

 Inputs

 • TempSupplyAir This Input takes the temperature from a sensor. By means of the parameters the Functional Block defines the change over status. This Input is used alternatively with the switch.

 • ChangeOverSwitch This Input takes the information from a normal switch. The relation on/off to heating/cooling may be defined by means of a parameter. Binding only is possible in the Standard Mode. This Input is used alternatively with the temperature.

 • ChangeOverMode This Input receives the information from a HMI (e.g. switch) which is operated by e.g. a person who is responsible for the heating/cooling. This Input has higher priority than the others. In the position AUTO the Input of the other Inputs is valid.

 Outputs

 • ChangeOverStatusAir This Output delivers the information heating or cooling to the controllers, in order to change the controller sequence.


-----

###### Binding Groups (LTE)

 • DistrSegmV This sensor can be used in different applications. General Peripheral Tag For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised.

 Parameters

 • empHeatingLevel If the temperature of the sensor is higher than this value, the Functional Block delivers heating to the system.

 • TempCoolingLevel If the temperature of the sensor is lower than this value, the Functional Block delivers cooling to the system.

 • SwitchDefinitionHeat/Cool Company specific definition of the relation between the hardware switch position and the bus information.

 • Heartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition (change of the Air Change Over Status) occurred before.

 • MinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.23.3 Constraints
###### The Input ‘ChangeOverSwitch’ only can be used in the S-Mode as a corresponding switch is not defined.

###### 3.23.6.5 Parameter DistrSegmV

**FB:** **ACOS** **Property Name** **DistrSegmV** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the distribution segment ventilation.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of DistrSegmV (0) 1...31
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 341 (ACOS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'

###### 3.23.6.9 Parameter SwitchDefinitionHeat/Cool

**FB:** **ACOS** **Property Name** **SwitchDefinitionHeat/Cool** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Defines the operation logic of the heat/cool switch.
**DPT:** Name DPT_Invert DPT ID 1.012 Datatype format B1
Field Description Sup. Range Unit

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 341 (ACOS) Property ID: 113
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.23.6.10 Parameter Heartbeat

**FB:** **ACOS** **Property Name (Server):** **Heartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 341 (ACOS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.23.6.11 Parameter MinRepTime

**FB:** **ACOS** **Property Name (Server):** **MinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 341 (ACOS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time; minimum repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.24 Dew Point Status Sensor (DPS)

##### 3.24.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Dew Point Status Sensor’ acquires the dew point status and provides it to the system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Dew Point Status Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the dew point status sensor functionality.

##### 3.24.2 Functional Specification
###### The distribution of the DewPointStatus in the system is event driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Dew Point Status Sensor' supports the LTE zoning  "Apartment . Room . SubZone"

 The information is transmitted spontaneously at each change.

 Outputs

 • DewPointStatus This Output provides the status of a dew point status sensor to the system.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone no special features

 Parameters

 • SwitchDefinitionDewPoint Company specific definition of the relation between the hardware switch/detector position and the bus information.

 • Heartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition (change of the Dew Point Status) occurred before.

 • MinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.24.3 Constraints
###### -None.

###### 3.24.6.2 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **DPS** **Property Name** **Apartment** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit Default
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126 1
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0 false

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA false
COMMAND enum cs

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 344 (DPS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.24.6.3 Parameter Room

**FB:** **DPS** **Property Name** **Room** Mandatory
**(Server):** Optional

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 344 (DPS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 344 (DPS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.24.6.7 Parameter MinRepTime

**FB:** **DPS** **Property Name (Server):** **MinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 344 (DPS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value

#### 3.25 Discharge Air Temperature Sensor (DATS)

##### 3.25.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Discharge Air Temperature Sensor’ measures the discharge air temperature e.g. in a fancoil duct and delivers it to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Discharge Air Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the discharge air temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.25.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the discharge air temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Discharge Air Temperature Sensor' supports the following LTE zoning:
 - "Apartment . Room . SubZone",
 - "General Peripheral Tag".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempDischargeAir This Output delivers the discharge air temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempDischargeAir.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone This sensor can be used in different applications. GenPeripheral For this reason different binding possibilities are offered. It is even possible to have more than one binding group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all possibilities have to be realised. See Detailed specification of the Datapoints in clause 3.4.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.


-----

###### • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

##### 3.25.3 Constraints
###### None.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **DATS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempDischargeAir** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the discharge air temperature as well as a STATUS information. The
Output may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,2 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1 [2)]
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable 1 [2)]
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 328 (DATS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)] min

InfoReport Output per default communicating Binding Group Wildcard allowed

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown
--**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter
2) This sensor can be used in different applications. It is even possible to have more than one binding
group active. The binding groups that shall not be active have to be set to out of service. Not all
possibilities have to be realised. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually
also the 'Room' are not needed. In such a case these parameters have to be set fix to 1.

###### 3.25.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **DATS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone (0) 1...126
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 328(DATS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.25.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **DATS** **Property Name (Server):** **Room** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the room zone (0) 1...63
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 328 (DATS) Property ID: 102
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### 3.25.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **DATS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset

 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0

 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum

 - NormalWrite M 0

 - SetOSV & ResetOSV Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 328 (DATS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.4.2.

###### 3.25.6.11 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB:** **DATS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 328 (DATS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.25.6.12 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB:** **DATS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of [0 ... Heartbeat] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 328 (DATS) Property ID: 116
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable

#### 3.26 Floor Temperature Sensor (FTS)

##### 3.26.1 Aims and objectives
###### The Functional Block ‘Floor Temperature Sensor’ measures the floor temperature and delivers the data to the bus / system.

 This Functional Block is used e.g. in a ‘Floor Temperature Sensor Device’ or in a more complex device that has the floor temperature sensor functionality.

##### 3.26.2 Functional specifications
###### The distribution of the floor temperature in the system is event-driven (COV-condition, change of value) and in addition repeated periodically.

 Optional feature:
 - The sensor value may be corrected by a parameter value.

 In the LTE-Mode the 'Floor Temperature Sensor' supports the LTE zoning "Apartment . Room . SubZone".

 Optional features in LTE-Mode:
 - Faults in the sensor device may be detected and reported.
 - The sensor value may temporary be overridden by means of a tool for service purposes.    The ‘Overridden’ condition must be reported.
 - Alarm limits may be detected by the sensor and are reported.    The alarm may be acknowledged.
 - The sensor may be set / reset out of service by means of a tool for service purposes.

 Outputs

 • TempFloor This Output delivers the floor temperature to the bus.

 • StatusGO This Output only is available in standard mode and contains the Z8 information of the Output TempFloor.

 Binding Group (LTE)

 • Apartment . Room . SubZone See Detailed specification of the Datapoints 3.3.6. For certain residential applications the 'SubZone' and eventually also the 'Room' are not needed. In this case these parameters have to be set fix to 1. Wildcard on apartment is NOT allowed.

 Parameters

 • TempCorrValue This parameter specifies the correction value for the sensor.

 • TempCOVCondition This parameter defines the delta temperature value at which the information spontaneously is transmitted.

 • TempAlarmLimitUpper This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempAlarmLimitLower This value can be used to create an alarm.

 • TempHeartbeat This parameter defines the time duration for periodical retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.

 • TempMinRepTime This parameter defines the time duration for earliest  retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition  occurred before.

###### LTE-Mode:

**FB:** **FTS** **LTE Server Output Name: TempFloor** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
This Output contains the value of the floor temperature as well as a STATUS information. The Output
may be overridden by means of the COMMAND.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit COV Default
Temperature Actual temperature value Full Range °C 0,2 [1) ] cs
STATUS For LTE-service InfoReport Bitset
and Property-Service
Response only

 - OutOfService Sensor out of service O true/false Bit 0 Y false

 - Fault Sensor value is corrupted O true/false Bit 1 Y false

 - Overridden Sensor is temporarily O true/false Bit 2 Y false
overridden

 - InAlarm Sensor is in alarm O true/false Bit 3 Y false

 - AlarmUnAck Acknowledgement of alarm O true/false Bit 4 Y false
all other bits reserved NA Bit 5-7 Y false
Sup. Range
COMMAND For Property-Service Write only enum

 - Override / Release Temporary override / release of sensor value O 1 / 2

 - Set / Reset OSV Set / reset of out of service O 3 / 4

 - AlarmAck Acknowledgement of alarm O 5

 - all other commands NA
**Communication:**

**Binding Group:**
Class Type Default
Geographical Apartment. Room . SubZone 1.1.1
Application Specific
Peripheral Broadcast Configurable
**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 329 (FTS) Property ID: 51
**LTE-services (event):** COV MinRepTime: 10 [1)] s Heartbeat: 15 [1)]

InfoReport Output per default communicating

Binding Group Wildcard allowed [2)]

(LTE Read-Response Tx Prio: High Normal Low
polling of the Output
shall always be Transm after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
supported)

**Property-Service**
Read only Read/Write
**(individual access):**

**Exception Handling:** Save at Powerdown

[2)] Wildcard on apartment is NOT allowed
**Special Features:**

[1)] COV, MinRepTime, Heartbeat: see parameter

###### 3.26.6.3 Parameter Apartment

**FB:** **FTS** **Property Name (Server):** **Apartment** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the apartment zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the apartment zone
NA 0
M 1...126
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 329 (FTS) Property ID: 101
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
Zone = 0 (wildcard): NOT allowed
**Special Features:**
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
If Apartment is 'OutOfService' Room and SubZone automatically are 'OutOfService'

###### 3.26.6.4 Parameter Room

**FB:** **FTS** **Property Name (Server):**

**Description:**
Number of the room zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z
Field Description
Zone Number of the room zone
STATUS
 - OutofService zone active / inactive
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0'
COMMAND
 - NormalWrite
 - SetOSV & Set zone inactive / active
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID):
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment

###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.26.2.

###### 3.26.6.5 Parameter SubZone

**FB:** **FTS** **Property Name (Server):** **SubZone** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Number of the sub zone.
**DPT:** Name DPT_UcountValue8_Z DPT ID 202.002 Datatype format U8Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Zone Number of the SubZone (0) 1...15
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService zone active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set zone inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 329 (FTS) Property ID: 103
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
Zone = 0 (wildcard): Sends to all listeners
The device is not LTE communicating in this zone if zone is 'OutOfService'
'OutOfService' is taken over from Apartment
###### *[)] See functional specifications in clause 3.26.2

###### 3.26.6.9 Parameter TempAlarmLimitLower

**FB:** **FTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempAlarmLimitLower** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
Lower temperature value for alarm.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TempHVACAbs_Z DPT ID 205.100 Datatype format V16Z8
Field Description Sup. Range Unit
Temperature Temperature limit value Full Range °C
STATUS Bitset
 - OutofService limit active / inactive O true/false Bit 0
 - all other bits not supported, fixed to '0' NA
COMMAND enum
 - NormalWrite M 0
 - SetOSV & Set limit inactive / active O 3 / 4
ResetOSV

 - all other commands not supported NA
**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 329 (FTS) Property ID: 114
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
--
###### 3.26.6.10 Parameter TempHeartbeat

**FB:** **FTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempHeartbeat** Mandatory
Optional
**Description:**
The time duration for retransimission of the sensor value if no COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID 7.005 Datatype format U16
Field Description Sup. Range
Time period Period for latest retransmission of [0, MinRepTime ... 65535] [1)] s
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 329 (FTS) Property ID: 115
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1 N° of elements 1

**Property access:** Read only Read/Write
**Protection** Read level  - Write level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value Act Value Default Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no heartbeat; heartbeats smaller than MinRepTime not applicable

###### 3.26.6.11 Parameter TempMinRepTime

**FB:** **FTS** **Property Name (Server):** **TempMinRepTime**

**Description:**
Time duration for earliest retransmission of the sensor value even if the COV condition occurred before.
**DPT:** Name DPT_TimePeriodSec DPT ID
Field Description
Time period Period for earliest retransmission of
sensor value

**Communication:**

**DP Address:** IO Type(ID): 329 (FTS)
**(in the server)** Start-Index: 1

**Property access:** Read only
**Protection** Read level  **Exception Handling:** Value after Power-up: Stored Value
--**Special Features:**
1) 0 = no minimum repetition time (not recommended when using small COV condition); minimum

repetition time greater than Heartbeat not applicable
